verification.method: Byte replay of every rule claim on the lock-equal Engine.dll and the lock-equal E: maps, every claim supported, no lock mismatch

levelBaseReferenceArrays.condition: UObject::Serialize, then the object reference array at +0x48 only when LicenseeVer >= 23 (cmp 0x17), then the +0x38 array, then FURL at +0x78

levelModelReference.condition: tests the package Ver, not LicenseeVer; the Model reference is ULevel+0xc0

surfaceTrailingInteger.condition: after the float32 at +0x3c, one int32 at +0x40 only when LicenseeVer >= 21 (cmp 0x15, jl); below 21 no bytes are read and loading sets +0x40 to -1

renderSection.condition: every licensee: vertex array, revision, material object reference, node count, flags, final int32
renderSection.revision: GetRevision of FBspVertexStream; it rises with the node count when a node is added, so it is never compared with the node count or the model node array length
renderSection.nodeCount: the assigned non-empty nodes: node +0x56 above 0 with node +0x60 the section index and node +0x64 the first vertex
renderSection.vertexCheck: the vertex array length equals the summed vertex counts of the assigned nodes

renderVertex.condition: the trailing members are serialized when the package Ver >= 109

open: the serializer addresses of FBspSection and FBspVertex are not part of the verified facts
model lightmaps: below LicenseeVer 24 the loader copies the arrays in memory with no stream bytes, and the data check did not consume the model lightmap tail end to end
